info.name: ViStay Pricing Authoring
info.description: Opt-in SCRUM-354 pricing-profile authoring flow. The collection creates one immutable property pricing version, proves exact idempotent replay, exercises validation and authorization denial, then reads the authored version. Clear pricingIdempotencyKey before intentionally changing the happy-path payload.

body.raw: {"query":"mutation CreatePricing($input: CreatePropertyRateProfileVersionInput!) { createPropertyRateProfileVersion(input: $input) { id propertyId version effectiveFrom effectiveToExclusive baseDailyRate mediumDailyFactorBps longDailyFactorBps currency checkInTime checkOutTime turnoverMinutes quoteTtlMinutes commissionDefaultBps commissionMaxBps reason authoredByAdminAccountId correlationId authoredAt rules { id code name effectiveFrom effectiveToExclusive priority daysOfWeek channels minimumStayDays maximumStayDays minimumGuests maximumGuests actionType actionValue } } }","variables":{"input":{"idempotencyKey":"{{pricingIdempotencyKey}}","propertyId":"{{pricingPropertyId}}","effectiveFrom":"{{pricingEffectiveFrom}}","effectiveToExclusive":"{{pricingEffectiveToExclusive}}","baseDailyRate":"{{pricingBaseDailyRate}}","mediumDailyFactorBps":7000,"longDailyFactorBps":5500,"checkInTime":"14:00","checkOutTime":"12:00","turnoverMinutes":120,"quoteTtlMinutes":15,"commissionDefaultBps":500,"commissionMaxBps":2000,"reason":"Postman verifies immutable pricing authoring","correlationId":"postman-scrum-354","rules":[{"code":"short_weekend_v1","name":"Short stay weekend surcharge","effectiveFrom":"{{pricingEffectiveFrom}}","effectiveToExclusive":"{{pricingEffectiveToExclusive}}","priority":100,"daysOfWeek":[6,7],"channels":["ADMIN_PORTAL","CUSTOMER_WEB","OTA"],"minimumStayDays":1,"maximumStayDays":29,"minimumGuests":1,"maximumGuests":20,"actionType":"PERCENT_SURCHARGE","actionValue":"1000"}]}}}

{"query":"mutation CreatePricing($input: CreatePropertyRateProfileVersionInput!) { createPropertyRateProfileVersion(input: $input) { id propertyId version effectiveFrom effectiveToExclusive baseDailyRate mediumDailyFactorBps longDailyFactorBps currency checkInTime checkOutTime turnoverMinutes quoteTtlMinutes commissionDefaultBps commissionMaxBps reason authoredByAdminAccountId correlationId authoredAt rules { id code name effectiveFrom effectiveToExclusive priority daysOfWeek channels minimumStayDays maximumStayDays minimumGuests maximumGuests actionType actionValue } } }","variables":{"input":{"idempotencyKey":"{{pricingIdempotencyKey}}","propertyId":"{{pricingPropertyId}}","effectiveFrom":"{{pricingEffectiveFrom}}","effectiveToExclusive":"{{pricingEffectiveToExclusive}}","baseDailyRate":"{{pricingBaseDailyRate}}","mediumDailyFactorBps":7000,"longDailyFactorBps":5500,"checkInTime":"14:00","checkOutTime":"12:00","turnoverMinutes":120,"quoteTtlMinutes":15,"commissionDefaultBps":500,"commissionMaxBps":2000,"reason":"Postman verifies immutable pricing authoring","correlationId":"postman-scrum-354","rules":[{"code":"short_weekend_v1","name":"Short stay weekend surcharge","effectiveFrom":"{{pricingEffectiveFrom}}","effectiveToExclusive":"{{pricingEffectiveToExclusive}}","priority":100,"daysOfWeek":[6,7],"channels":["ADMIN_PORTAL","CUSTOMER_WEB","OTA"],"minimumStayDays":1,"maximumStayDays":29,"minimumGuests":1,"maximumGuests":20,"actionType":"PERCENT_SURCHARGE","actionValue":"1000"}]}}}
